# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before working, read the repository-root `AGENTS.md` and the authorized ticket in `docs/tickets/README.md`. Work only on `feat/zoho-crm`, verify the active branch, and stop if it differs. Implement only one explicitly requested ticket; verify its dependencies, acceptance criteria, tests, and external requirements. Do not start another ticket automatically.

Follow the v2 architecture and security rules in `AGENTS.md`. Keep ticket status, architecture/setup/decisions, and real test evidence current. Never claim an unexecuted test passed or include secrets in code, workflow exports, examples, or frontend configuration. Preserve unrelated changes and do not commit automatically.
